scope: All 24 selected original artworks and their 22 current print editions. Superseded editions, unselected workbook archives and independent generated illustrations are outside this comparison.
standard: Cleanup may reduce verified paper stains, dust and photographic unevenness. It must not redraw a stroke, invent a feature, clarify intentional ambiguity, change expression, fill ink, alter proportions or regenerate signatures.
method: Visual original/current comparisons at preserved aspect ratios, with repeat inspection of sensitive faces; checksum validation of all selected originals/current editions; direct pixel-region verification for three non-generative preparations.
limits: Judgments of acceptable drift are curatorial recommendations for the artist, not measured similarity scores. Comparisons use the available digital photographs, not physical works or colour-calibrated scans. Framing/scale, camera perspective and resampling affect appearance. No pixel-identity claim is made for generated editions or enlarged JPEGs. Faint marks cannot be reliably classified as dirt without artist confirmation.

artworks.title: The Witness
artworks.observation: The profile and gaze remain recognisable, but the cheek, eye surround and neck highlights have been re-articulated; some paint transitions are crisper. The replacement paper is acceptable, but repainting internal marks is beyond cleanup.
artworks.recommendation: Preserve the original painted head and handwritten signature; clean only confidently identified paper defects. Prior artist approval is not revoked by this review.

artworks.title: The Gathering
artworks.observation: The current v3 artwork region is pixel-identical to the decoded original. The former generated edition is no longer active.
artworks.recommendation: Keep current edition; retain its soft merging figures.

artworks.title: Inner Moon
artworks.observation: The facial marks and the fine scratched/painted texture around the face and enclosing curve differ. The composition survives, but clearer marks change its delicate expression.
artworks.recommendation: Return to original facial and scratched marks; avoid resolving ambiguous details.

artworks.title: Held
artworks.observation: The crouched gesture and main paint bands remain close. Interior marks in the torso and limb bands look more sharply articulated, even though the overall rhythm is retained.
artworks.recommendation: Keep the current artist-approved version pending comparison; do not certify it as background-only cleanup.

artworks.title: The Pause
artworks.observation: The bowed gesture and simple shapes are close. Surface grain and some edges differ; handwritten lettering has been regenerated rather than preserved as original pixels.
artworks.recommendation: No urgent subject correction apparent; check the contour and signature against the original before calling it a faithful cleanup.

artworks.title: The Vessel
artworks.observation: The main silhouette, top opening and sweeping bands are close. Small dry-brush gaps and wash texture differ and appear more distinct.
artworks.recommendation: A comparatively close result; retain original brush gaps in any further preparation.

artworks.title: The Hollow
artworks.observation: The current v3 artwork region is pixel-identical to the decoded original, including broken ink and irregular fill.
artworks.recommendation: Keep current edition.

artworks.title: Inner Voices
artworks.observation: The assembly and interlocking forms remain. Green contours and small facial marks appear firmer, reducing some of the original fading and uncertainty.
artworks.recommendation: Inspect small faces before approval; do not strengthen faded marks as cleanup.

artworks.title: Inward
artworks.observation: The bowed figure remains, but the nose, eyelids and head hatching are more emphatic. Some long contours also look more definite.
artworks.recommendation: Preserve the original face and charcoal softness. Removing the photographed paper obstruction is a separate decision from redrawing a contour it obscures.

artworks.title: Almost
artworks.observation: The paired birds and near-contact gesture remain. Thin line texture and hatching differ; the surrounding dark ground is more even.
artworks.recommendation: Removing glare can be acceptable, but retain the original line ends and uncertain fine marks.

artworks.title: Grandmother
artworks.observation: The current v3 drawing region is pixel-identical to the decoded original, preserving the actual expression and hatching.
artworks.recommendation: Keep current edition.

artworks.title: Shelter
artworks.observation: The paired birds, sheltering leaves and diagonal setting remain. Leaf divisions, bird edges and background strokes appear crisper.
artworks.recommendation: Check that increased clarity has not become invented leaf detail; avoid another generative pass.

artworks.title: Belonging
artworks.observation: The broad interrelated forms remain, but ochre boundaries and fine paint striations have become stronger and more explicit, especially through the centre and lower portion.
artworks.recommendation: Keep the original soft wash and stroke hierarchy; do not convert faint paint to assertive detail.

artworks.title: The Offering
artworks.observation: The dance pose remains, but eyes, nose, mouth, finger contours and some ornament lines have been re-drawn more crisply. BAPU lettering is not a pixel-preserved signature.
artworks.recommendation: Use the original figure and signature; clean only surrounding paper.

artworks.title: Together
artworks.observation: The two figures and flowing relationship are close. Some contour thickness, curve endings and fine breaks differ.
artworks.recommendation: One of the closer compositions; compare thin line joins before accepting as cleanup.

artworks.title: Ember
artworks.observation: The silhouette and pose remain, but internal red/blue paint detail is more pronounced and the field is more uniform. Changes within the figure go beyond removing external blemishes.
artworks.recommendation: Preserve internal paint patches and their softness; do not intensify them to look more detailed.

artworks.title: The Balance
artworks.observation: No active generated counterpart exists. Original source checksum matches the catalogue.
artworks.recommendation: Preserve charcoal smudging and faint figure boundaries; these are not automatically dirt.

artworks.title: Unwritten
artworks.observation: The silhouette remains, but the printed substrate lettering and small blue motif have been reconstructed, with differences in local strokes and spacing.
artworks.recommendation: Treat the printed paper and blue motif as part of the source artwork, not background noise. Preserve them directly.

artworks.title: Sanctuary
artworks.observation: The seated form and patterned garment remain close. Small fold/ornament lines and edge texture differ.
artworks.recommendation: Background cleanup is useful here, but preserve all fine garment marks and ink gaps.

artworks.title: The Journey
artworks.observation: The walking figure remains, but facial marks, folds and dark foot/ground strokes are more resolved and locally different.
artworks.recommendation: Preserve the original facial paint and loose ground strokes; do not fill or sharpen them.

artworks.title: Resolve
artworks.observation: The dynamic cropped form remains. Dense hatch marks and visible paper fibres are more emphatic in places.
artworks.recommendation: Keep stroke breaks and fibres that belong to the support; do not mistake all texture for noise.

artworks.title: Remembered
artworks.observation: No active generated counterpart exists. Original source checksum matches the catalogue.
artworks.recommendation: The faint face/body relationship is essential; do not invent lines to clarify it.

artworks.title: Within Reach
artworks.observation: The corrected narrow presentation is closer to the original. The merging figures remain, but local blue grain and pale contour passages differ.
artworks.recommendation: No urgent subject correction apparent. Leave as requested, while recognising that it is not verified background-only cleanup.

artworks.title: Unwatched
artworks.observation: The turned-back gesture and flowing hair remain. Hair hatching, fine contour breaks and lower loop/foot lines differ locally.
artworks.recommendation: Keep the original incomplete lines; do not finish the drawing during cleanup.
